# Signal Fish Godot Client

> Pure-GDScript Signal Fish protocol client for Godot 4. Drop-in addon: no C#,
> no GDExtension, nothing to compile. Runs everywhere Godot runs, including
> web exports.

## Core Context

- [Canonical AI Context](./.llm/context.md): required starting point for agents.
- [Generated LLM Index](./.llm/index.md): inventory of skills, samples, and
  research notes.

## Docs

Published site: <https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/>

- [Installation & Quick Start](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/getting-started/): install the addon, configure, connect, join a room.
- [Client API Reference](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/client/): config fields, lifecycle methods, send methods, state machines.
- [Events](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/events/): the signal surface and typed payload objects.
- [Errors](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/errors/): the error-code enum and where errors surface.
- [Game Data](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/game-data/): JSON, MessagePack, binary frames, and rkyv pass-through.
- [Reconnection & Replay](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/reconnection/): tokens, missed-event replay, auto-reconnect backoff.
- [Web Export](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/web-export/): browser rules for wss, Origin, storage, and polling.
- [Deterministic Testing](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/testing/): fixture suites and the runtime check entry point.
- [Mesh (v3)](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/mesh-guide/): WebRTC session plans and the `SFWebRTCMesh` node.
- [Brand & Font Attribution](https://ambiguous-interactive.github.io/signal-fish-client-godot/attributions/): logo and font licenses.
